notes.title: Beta Multiplayer activated 24/7 for all Latin America
notes.notes:
From today we activate our servers in Brazil for all Latin America. It is the first Paraguayan PC game to achieve this feat. We will continue adding more maps and new weapons. Enjoy it!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28998584/be3b1c563b25956b54d016bfa9d347561526bb0b.jpg[/img]

-Improved augmented reality design
